subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/CodingPlan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source shows a real split between general and CodingPlan endpoints, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm the vendor entitlement contract and decide whether to reroute, diagnose, or leave the split explicit.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/CodingPlan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on CodingPlan
options.body: If the key is only valid for `volcengine-plan`, keep general models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the key should work on the general endpoint too, treat the 401 as a runtime/auth bug and fix the credential/header path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/CodingPlan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, and setup/runtime compatibility surfaces where the live history is strongest.
